related.title: 福清 5 號華龍一號示範機組
related.transfer: 可遷移「年發電量與容量因數」與「儀控表決邏輯與可靠度」的定量模型、量測與驗證方法；福清 5 號華龍一號示範機組的資源條件、容量、設備與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The quantitative models, measurement and verification methods of "Annual energy and capacity factor" and "Voting logic and reliability of instrumentation and control" transfer, while resource conditions, capacity, equipment and acceptance conditions of Fuqing 5 Hualong One Demonstration Unit must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦VVER-1200 首堆：臥式蒸汽產生器、全速汽輪機與空冷式非能動餘熱移除；福清 5 號華龍一號示範機組則以華龍一號首堆：能動與非能動結合的安全系統與雙層圍阻體為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on the first VVER-1200: horizontal steam generators, a full-speed turbine and air-cooled passive heat removal; Fuqing 5 Hualong One Demonstration Unit centres on the first Hualong One: combined active and passive safety systems and double containment, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「熱功率、電功率與淨效率」與「熱功率、電功率與淨效率」的能量輸入、轉換路徑與主要環境條件。
把本課「全速核能汽輪機與長葉片」的模型移到福清 5 號華龍一號示範機組，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「儀控表決邏輯與可靠度」為例，設計一項能區分兩個工程行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list energy inputs, conversion paths and main environmental conditions of "Thermal power, electrical power and net efficiency" and "Thermal power, electrical power and net efficiency".
Move the model of "A full-speed nuclear turbine and long blades" to Fuqing 5 Hualong One Demonstration Unit, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Voting logic and reliability of instrumentation and control", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two projects and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.
related.why: 可遷移「年發電量與容量因數」與「儀控表決邏輯與可靠度」的定量模型、量測與驗證方法；福清 5 號華龍一號示範機組的資源條件、容量、設備與允收條件需重新設定。
related.whyEn: The quantitative models, measurement and verification methods of "Annual energy and capacity factor" and "Voting logic and reliability of instrumentation and control" transfer, while resource conditions, capacity, equipment and acceptance conditions of Fuqing 5 Hualong One Demonstration Unit must be respecified.

related.title: 奧爾基洛托 3 號 EPR 機組
related.transfer: 可遷移「年發電量與容量因數」與「儀控表決邏輯與可靠度」的定量模型、量測與驗證方法；奧爾基洛托 3 號 EPR 機組的資源條件、容量、設備與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The quantitative models, measurement and verification methods of "Annual energy and capacity factor" and "Voting logic and reliability of instrumentation and control" transfer, while resource conditions, capacity, equipment and acceptance conditions of Olkiluoto 3 EPR Unit must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦VVER-1200 首堆：臥式蒸汽產生器、全速汽輪機與空冷式非能動餘熱移除；奧爾基洛托 3 號 EPR 機組則以首座開工的 EPR：熔融物滯留裝置、數位儀控多樣性與起動試驗為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on the first VVER-1200: horizontal steam generators, a full-speed turbine and air-cooled passive heat removal; Olkiluoto 3 EPR Unit centres on the first EPR to start construction: core catcher, digital I&C diversity and start-up testing, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「熱功率、電功率與淨效率」與「熱功率、電功率與淨效率」的能量輸入、轉換路徑與主要環境條件。
把本課「全速核能汽輪機與長葉片」的模型移到奧爾基洛托 3 號 EPR 機組，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「數位儀控的多樣性要求」為例，設計一項能區分兩個工程行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list energy inputs, conversion paths and main environmental conditions of "Thermal power, electrical power and net efficiency" and "Thermal power, electrical power and net efficiency".
Move the model of "A full-speed nuclear turbine and long blades" to Olkiluoto 3 EPR Unit, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Diversity requirements for digital I&C", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two projects and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.
related.why: 可遷移「年發電量與容量因數」與「儀控表決邏輯與可靠度」的定量模型、量測與驗證方法；奧爾基洛托 3 號 EPR 機組的資源條件、容量、設備與允收條件需重新設定。
related.whyEn: The quantitative models, measurement and verification methods of "Annual energy and capacity factor" and "Voting logic and reliability of instrumentation and control" transfer, while resource conditions, capacity, equipment and acceptance conditions of Olkiluoto 3 EPR Unit must be respecified.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 新沃羅涅日二期 VVER-1200 機組
history.text: 2008 年1 號機開工；2016 年1 號機併網，為首部 VVER-1200；2017 年1 號機商轉；2019 年2 號機商轉。本課只重建公開原理與工程邏輯，不代表任何專案的設計或運轉文件。
history.textEn: 2008: Construction of unit 1 began. 2016: Unit 1 was connected, the first VVER-1200. 2017: Unit 1 entered commercial operation. 2019: Unit 2 entered commercial operation. This course reconstructs public principles and engineering logic only, not any project's design or operating documents.
